messages:
dena: Heads-up: found a reproducible hang in JS SDK when streaming paginated embeddings + adaptive windowing + STS refresh. No 429s; stream shows inflight forever.
ravi: are there logs?
dena: yes, minimal repro with sampleapp: concurrency=5, page_size=100, adaptiveWindow=true. After ~20s (refresh) a couple streams stop getting chunks.
eli: paste SDK debug output?
dena: small trace:
[DEBUG] window: shrink 5->2
[DEBUG] auth: refresh start
[DEBUG] inflight: release stream#3
[DEBUG] inflight: notify waiters -> 0
[DEBUG] stream#3: waiting for next chunk (no callback)
[DEBUG] inflight: acquire timeout
ravi: that "notify waiters -> 0" is suspect. looks like reset cleared waiters before notify.
eli: workaround for now: set adaptiveWindow=false or lower concurrency. We'll patch resetInflight to snapshot waiters and notify before clearing.
sdk-ci: PR #5021 opened by eli: fix(backpressure): preserve notify ordering during auth refresh + unit test. CI queued.
ops-bot: Note: add troubleshooting blurb to sampleapp README and onboarding docs.
dena: thanks all — will attach SDK_DEBUG logs when filing a support ticket.
